bug: `<=` lowered to Less_: the Equal dropped, an off-by-one at the boundary
effect: `if (Health <= 0)` does not fire at exactly 0; `for (I = 1; I <= N; ++I)` stops one pass early

old: Cast == "FloatingToIntegral" && FK == SK_Float && (TK == SK_Int || TK == SK_Int64)
new: Cast == "FloatingToIntegral" && FK == SK_Float && (TK == SK_Int || TK == SK_Int64) && StrKindOf(Canon(TypeOf(N))) != SK_Float
bug: a float-to-int cast whose result goes back into a float is taken for a no-op round trip
effect: `float W = (int32)F;` keeps the fraction: snapping to whole numbers does nothing

old: Out = Math("Divide_", Math("And_", std::move(LA), Const(~((1LL << N) - 1))), Const(1LL << N));
bug: signed `>>` lowered as a division by 2^N: Divide truncates toward zero, a shift rounds down
effect: -3 >> 1 gives -1 instead of -2; -1 >> 4 gives 0 instead of -1

bug: the destination is not passed as the context call's r-value, so EX_Context has none to clear
effect: `X = Obj->Get()` with Obj None leaves X holding its old value instead of zero

bug: off-by-one in where the OR chain starts: the second comparison overwrites the first
effect: `kList.Contains(X)` over an inline constant list is false when X matches only the first element

bug: postfix and prefix swapped: X++ yields the new value, ++X the old
effect: `Items[I++]` reads element I+1; `Old = N++` gets N+1; `while (N-- > 0)` stops a pass early

bug: a member of a variable is taken as safe to write straight into the destination, which may be that variable
effect: `V = FVector(V.Y, V.X, V.Z)` reads members it already overwrote: V becomes (Y, Y, Z)

bug: the negation of `>=` taken as `<=` (mirrored instead of negated)
effect: `if (I >= N) break;` breaks only once I > N; `!(A >= B)` is true when A == B

old: InRange.Sub->Args = { Value, Int(Run.Min), Int(Run.Max), Bool(true), Bool(true) };
new: InRange.Sub->Args = { Value, Int(Run.Min), Int(Run.Max), Bool(true), Bool(false) };
bug: a switch jump table's range check excludes its maximum
effect: the largest value of each run of 3+ nearby case values runs `default` instead of its case

bug: the `if (!Cond) break;` replacing a hoisted while condition goes at the end of the body, not the front
effect: the loop body runs once before the test; with `continue` it never tests (hangs)

bug: a declaration with no initializer inside a loop is not made fresh on each pass
effect: `TArray<int32> Row;` in a loop keeps the previous pass's elements

bug: the constant an earlier expansion bound to an inline parameter is not cleared before the next binds it
effect: after `Twice(3)`, a later `Twice(Health)` still computes with 3

bug: the receiver of a container method on a map element is never stored back
effect: `Groups[Key].Add(X)` on a TMap of arrays changes only a temporary copy

old: U < Stmts.size() && Mentions(Stmts[U], Name) == 0 && MayPass(Stmts[U], E, bActs)
bug: a single-use local is forwarded past statements that run calls or store
effect: `int32 Before = Ammo; Fire(); Print(Before);` prints the ammo after Fire()

bug: liveness forgets the back edge: a local set before a loop and last read inside it is not live over the loop
effect: a temp inside the loop can share its property, so later passes read the temp's value

bug: an if/else counts as overwriting a local whenever its then-branch does; the else is not examined
effect: `int32 Dmg = 10; if (bCrit) Dmg = 30; else Log(); Apply(Dmg);` drops `= 10`: a normal hit applies 0

bug: a map default's delta drops a pair whenever the parent has the key, without comparing values
effect: a subclass or asset default that changes an existing key's value loads with the parent's value

bug: UE_SERVER mapped to the client RPC flag
effect: a Server RPC is cooked as a Client RPC: from the owning client it never reaches the server

bug: the default is folded from the initializer with its unary minus stripped
effect: `float Offset = -50.f;` loads as 50; every negative numeric default loses its sign

bug: a reference parameter is flagged out-only, without CPF_ReferenceParm
effect: every `T&` parameter becomes an output pin; it no longer matches a native parent's ref parameter

bug: && operands swapped: an override no longer hides its base's `= 0`
effect: a concrete class implementing its mod base's pure virtual is cooked Abstract: spawning it returns None

bug: a native subobject parent is named by its C++ member name instead of its object name
effect: `Comp->SetupAttachment(Mesh)` under ACharacter hangs off the capsule instead of the mesh

bug: the quaternion product of root and child rotation reversed
effect: under a rotated scene root, a rotated child is oriented wrong when the rotations do not commute

bug: copy-paste: CPF_Net set twice, CPF_RepNotify never
effect: a UE_REPLICATED_USING variable's OnRep never runs on clients

bug: the refusal of a set element or map key that cannot hash no longer covers bool
effect: TSet<bool> compiles silently instead of being refused as REFERENCE.md says

old: if (Super.V != 0) { *Err = R.CppName + "::" + Fn.Name + ": an override takes its parent's replication; drop the RPC marker"; return false; }
bug: the refusal of an RPC marker on an override is dropped
effect: UE_SERVER on an override compiles silently; the engine takes the parent's replication anyway

bug: the warning for a write to a BlueprintReadOnly member is never printed
effect: writing a UE_READONLY member compiles with no warning, against REFERENCE.md

bug: EX_Context's skip count written in on-disk bytes instead of the in-memory bytes the VM skips
effect: only with a None context object: the VM skips the wrong distance and resumes mid-instruction

bug: a narrow text literal with non-ASCII characters is not switched to the UTF-16 form
effect: an FText literal with characters past 0x7F displays garbled

bug: FName number splitting drops UE's leading-zero rule
effect: a name ending in _01 loads as _1: imports and paths naming it do not resolve

bug: FirstExportDependency written as a byte offset into the preload table instead of an entry index
effect: every export's run after the first points 4x too far: the event-driven loader reads wrong indices

bug: NumReplicatedProperties is written only for two or more replicated variables
effect: a class with exactly one replicated variable replicates nothing

old: for (const FPropertyDef& V : Vars) TypeRefs(V, Class.SerBeforeSer);
bug: the class's serialize-before-serialize edges leave out its variables' struct and enum types
effect: in some load orders the class links against an unserialized struct from another package

bug: off-by-one keeps the trailing '/' in each asset's PackagePath
effect: asset-registry queries by path (GetAssetsByPath on the mod folder) find none of the mod's assets

bug: when a patch replaces an export's preload run in place, the run starting where it ended is not moved
effect: a patched game package's next export reads the tail of the patched run as its own preload edges
